fields.v: Partly (0.5): independent researcher, no commercial tie; but the SELECTIVE strategy (wiki split and retrieval hint) is the author's own construction, while NONE and ALWAYS ON deliver the developers' unmodified AGENTS.md
fields.quote: 5. Selective is our construction, and its corpus is not content-matched.
fields.why: §5 counts an author who created an evaluated approach as its vendor and gives Partly when this applies to only some approaches; SELECTIVE is the author's construction, so Yes depends on treating it as a mere experimental condition.
fields.doubt: O autor diz que a estratégia SELECTIVE é construção sua (pág. 9). Pela regra de Q12, se a contares como abordagem avaliada criada pelo autor, fica Parcial (0,5); se for só uma condição experimental, fica Sim. Noutros estudos (ex.: static_kb) contaste condições dos autores; decide de forma coerente.
